Pomegranate Cranberry Baked Brie
By: Karen Kelly
Published: Monday, January 9, 2017 - 10:01pm

Ingredients




1 round of brie (8 oz)
6 oz fresh cranberries (1/2 bag)
¼ cup light brown sugar
2 tbsp pomegranate molasses
¼ tsp fresh thyme
½ cup pomegranate arils

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350º F. 2 In a small sauce pan, add all sauce ingredients except pomegranate arils. 3 Bring to a gentle boil then turn down to low. Stir frequently and cook for about 4-6 minutes. 4 Remove from heat and add pomegranate arils. Stir. 5 Scrape or carefully slice the top rind off of the brie. 6 Bake brie for about 10-15 minutes. 7 Remove from oven and add topping to brie. 8 Return to oven for 3-5 minutes just to warm topping. 9 Serve immediately with crackers, apples, pears or crostini.

About

Hosting a holiday party?  If so, you have to make this Pomegranate Cranberry Baked Brie.  It is perfect served warm from the oven at your next soiree. It is delicious on crackers, sliced pears or crostini.
